{"id":1817930838,"question_id":3501,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1762020579,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"113 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1817930838/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Delete Nodes From Linked List Present in Array","memory":"263.3 MB","code":"/**\n * Definition for singly-linked list.\n * struct ListNode {\n *     int val;\n *     ListNode *next;\n *     ListNode() : val(0), next(nullptr) {}\n *     ListNode(int x) : val(x), next(nullptr) {}\n *     ListNode(int x, ListNode *next) : val(x), next(next) {}\n * };\n */\nclass Solution {\npublic:\n    ListNode* modifiedList(vector<int>& nums, ListNode* head) {\n        unordered_set<int>st;\n        for(auto num : nums) st.insert(num);\n\n        while(head && st.count(head->val))\n        {\n            ListNode* temp = head;\n            head = head->next;\n        }\n\n        if(!head) return nullptr;\n\n        ListNode* curr = head->next;\n        ListNode* prev = head;\n\n        while(curr)\n        {\n            if(st.count(curr->val))\n            {\n                ListNode* temp = curr;\n                curr = curr->next;\n                prev->next = curr;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                prev = curr;\n                curr = curr->next;\n            }\n        }\n    return head;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"delete-nodes-from-linked-list-present-in-array","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1049}
